headline: Bring Spanish weather data into Home Assistant
intro: Connect to AEMET OpenData with a free API key obtained through registration. Choose a latitude and longitude to create weather entities for daily forecasts up to 6 days or hourly forecasts up to 3 days, alongside sensors for available conditions. AEMET OpenData is limited to Spanish territory; enable the radar option to create a weather radar image entity.
highlights: Use daily forecasts up to 6 days or hourly forecasts up to 3 days
Get sensors for available conditions, including temperature, humidity, precipitation, and nearby station or town details
Create a weather radar image entity when the radar option is enabled

flow.title: From AEMET OpenData to local forecasts
stages: Register for a free AEMET OpenData API key
Add the integration with an API key and latitude and longitude
Use weather and condition sensor entities for your location
